```lean
theorem lg_target {α : Type u_1} [LinearOrder α] [DenselyOrdered α] (s t : Finset α) [NoMaxOrder α] [NoMinOrder α] [Nonempty α] (H : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ y ∈ t, x < y) : ∃ b, (∀ x ∈ s, x < b) ∧ ∀ y ∈ t, b < y := by
  let s_max := supremum s
  let t_min := infimum t
  have : s_max < t_min := by
    intro h
    rw [le_antisymm_iff] at h
    cases h with h1 h2
    · contradiction (lt_irrefl s_max h1) (assume h3 : s_max ≤ t_min, h3)
    · contradiction (lt_irrefl t_min h2) (assume h3 : t_min ≥ s_max, h3)
  let b := s_max
  use b
  · intro x
    intro hx
    exact le_supremum hx
  · intro y
    intro hy
    exact lt_of_le_not_le (le_infimum hy) (assume h : b ≤ y, contradiction (lt_irrefl y h) (assume h' : y < b, h'))
```
